newsitem.title: USA: Glenborough in pacts on properties.
newsitem.headline: Glenborough in pacts on properties.

text.p: Glenborough Realty Trust Inc said Monday it signed definitive agreements to acquire approximately $207 million of real estate, $23 million of which closed on April 8.

In a statement, the company said the acquisitions, which include 34 properties from four sellers or selling groups, will be funded with cash and all are expected to close during the second quarter of 1997.
The properties, which are located in 15 states, include seven office, 21 industrial and three retail properties as well as three hotels, comprising 3.1 million square feet and 310 hotel rooms.

On April 8, Glenborough closed the acquisition of three properties from Lennar Partners for a combined purchase price of $22.8 million. The properties include the 56,000 square foot South Washington office building located in Alexandria, Va., the 79,825 square foot Fisher-Pierce R&D building in Weymouth, Mass., and the 146,125 square foot Southworth-Milton industrial building in Milford, Mass.

Of the remaining three transactions, the company has completed due diligence on two acquisitions which include three hotels operating as Country Suites By Carlson located in North Dakota and Minnesota comprising 310 rooms and a 15-story office building located in Bloomington, Minn.

The fourth transaction involves the acquisition of 27 properties for a combined purchase price of approximately $145 million from five real estate funds sponsored by T. Rowe Price. This acquisition is subject to additional due diligence by Glenborough and approval by the investor interests in each fund.
The proposed acquisition is supported by the management of each fund and the company said it is hopeful that the transaction can be completed by the end of the second quarter of 1997.
